cohort: 38 preterm infants (60% male) with gestational age ranging from 30 to 36 weeks admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit, KJO Hospital, Saudi Arabia with proven diagnosis of ROP and 27 preterm infants without ROP as controls.
finding: Serum apelin levels were significantly lower in preterm infants with ROP compared to controls at the time of diagnosis (4-6 weeks).
mod_finding: Cesarean section was identified as a risk factor for developing ROP.
